edges.sentence: We obtain our ROUGE scores using the package.[<pypi.python.org/pypi/pyrouge/0.1.3>] We also evaluate with the METEOR metric [Denkowski et al. 2014], both in exact match mode (rewarding only exact matches between words) and full mode (which additionally rewards matching stems, synonyms and paraphrases).[<www.cs.cmu.edu/ alavie/METEOR>] In addition to our own models, we also report the lead-3 baseline (which uses the first three sentences of the article as a summary), and compare to the only existing abstractive [Nallapati et al. 2016] and extractive [Nallapati et al. 2017] models on the full dataset.
